data.name: Query_AppraisalSanctionReport
data.value:
select HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode , HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName ,SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryName ,HRMS_SET_Employee.FatherName ,GradeName ,DepartmentName ,Set_Job.JobDesignationName ,Set_Section.SectionName ,APP.AppraisalCode as AppraisalCodeP, APP.AppraisalName as AppraisalNameP, APC.AppraisalCode as AppraisalCodeC, APC.AppraisalName as AppraisalNameC ,HRMS_AppraisalDetail.AppraisalDate ,HRMS_AppraisalDetail.RequiredRating ,HRMS_AppraisalDetail.PerformanceRating ,HRMS_AppraisalDetail.Comments ,HRMS_AppraisalDetail.PerformanceValue ,case when HRMS_AppraisalDetail.ChangeEmployeeTypeID = 1 then 'Permanent' when HRMS_AppraisalDetail.ChangeEmployeeTypeID = 2 then 'Contract' when HRMS_AppraisalDetail.ChangeEmployeeTypeID = 3 then 'DailyWages' when HRMS_AppraisalDetail.ChangeEmployeeTypeID = 4 then 'Seasonal Contract'when HRMS_AppraisalDetail.ChangeEmployeeTypeID = 5 then 'Seasonla DailyWages' end as ChangedEmployeeType ,Set_JD.JobDesignationName as ChangedDesignation ,HRMS_AppraisalDetail.EffectiveFrom ,HRMS_Appraisal.DocumentNo ,HRMS_Appraisal.DocumentDate ,HRMS_Appraisal.StartDate ,HRMS_Appraisal.IsApproved
from HRMS_Appraisal
inner join HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_Appraisal.PersonID and HRMS_SET_Employee.Status =1 and HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_Appraisal.CompanyID
left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_Appraisal.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status =1
left join SET_JobDesignation Set_Job on Set_Job.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Appraisal.DesignationID and Set_Job.status =1
inner join SET_Grade on SET_Grade.GradeID = HRMS_Appraisal.GradeID and SET_Grade.Status =1 and SET_Grade.CompanyID = HRMS_Appraisal.CompanyID
inner join HRMS_AppraisalDetail on HRMS_AppraisalDetail.AppraisalID = HRMS_Appraisal.AppraisalID and HRMS_AppraisalDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_Appraisal.CompanyID and HRMS_AppraisalDetail.Status =1
inner JOIN [HRMS_Set_Appraisal] APC ON APC.AppraisalCode = HRMS_AppraisalDetail.AppraisalCode AND APC.[Status] = 1
left join [HRMS_Set_Appraisal] APP on APP.AppraisalName = APC.ParentAppraisalName and APP.Status =1
left join Set_JobDesignation Set_JD on Set_JD.JobDesignationID = HRMS_AppraisalDetail.ChangeEmployeeTypeID
left join SET_JobCategory on SET_JobCategory.JobCategoryID = HRMS_Appraisal.JobCategoryID and SET_JobCategory.Status =1 and SET_JobCategory.CompanyID = HRMS_Appraisal.CompanyID
left join SET_Section on SET_Section.SectionID = HRMS_Appraisal.SectionID and SET_Section.Status = 1
where HRMS_Appraisal.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_Appraisal.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0}

data.name: Query_SelectAllSearch
data.value:
SELECT distinct [HRMS_Appraisal].[CompanyID], [HRMS_Appraisal].[PeriodID], [HRMS_Appraisal].[AppraisalID], [HRMS_Appraisal].[CreateDate], [HRMS_Appraisal].[PersonID], [HRMS_SET_Employee].[FullName], [HRMS_Appraisal].[DesignationID], [HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[Comments], [HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[PromotionTo], [HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[PerformanceValue], [HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[ChangeEmployeeTypeID], [HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[EffectiveFrom], [HRMS_AppraisalOfficer].[IsRequest], [HRMS_AppraisalOfficer].[ApprovingAuthority], [HRMS_AppraisalOfficer].[AppraisalOfficerID], case when [HRMS_Appraisal].[IsApproved]=1 then 'Lock' else 'UnLock' end as DataMode, ROW_NUMBER() Over (Order by [HRMS_Appraisal].[CompanyID], [HRMS_Appraisal].[AppraisalID], [HRMS_Appraisal].[PeriodID]) as 'Row'
FROM [HRMS_Appraisal]
INNER JOIN HRMS_AppraisalDetail ON HRMS_AppraisalDetail.AppraisalID = HRMS_Appraisal.AppraisalID AND HRMS_AppraisalDetail.[CompanyID] = HRMS_Appraisal.[CompanyID] AND HRMS_AppraisalDetail.[PeriodID] = HRMS_Appraisal.[PeriodID] AND HRMS_AppraisalDetail.[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee ON HRMS_Appraisal.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_Appraisal.CompanyID = HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [HRMS_AppraisalOfficer] on [HRMS_AppraisalOfficer].[DesignationID] = [HRMS_Appraisal].[DesignationID] and [HRMS_AppraisalOfficer].[AppraisalOfficerID] = HRMS_AppraisalDetail.[AppraisalUserID] and [HRMS_AppraisalOfficer].[Status]=1 and [HRMS_AppraisalOfficer].[CompanyID]=[HRMS_Appraisal].[CompanyID] and [HRMS_AppraisalOfficer].[PeriodID]=[HRMS_Appraisal].[PeriodID]
WHERE [HRMS_Appraisal].[Status] = 1 AND ([HRMS_Appraisal].[IsApproved] =0 OR [HRMS_Appraisal].[IsApproved] = 1) AND [HRMS_Appraisal].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [HRMS_Appraisal].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [HRMS_Appraisal].[CreatedBy] = @UserID
group by [HRMS_Appraisal].[CompanyID], [HRMS_Appraisal].[PeriodID], [HRMS_Appraisal].[AppraisalID], [HRMS_Appraisal].[CreateDate], [HRMS_Appraisal].[PersonID], [HRMS_SET_Employee].[FullName], [HRMS_Appraisal].[DesignationID], [HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[Comments], [HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[PromotionTo], [HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[PerformanceValue], [HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[ChangeEmployeeTypeID], [HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[EffectiveFrom], [HRMS_AppraisalOfficer].[IsRequest], [HRMS_AppraisalOfficer].[ApprovingAuthority], [HRMS_AppraisalOfficer].[AppraisalOfficerID], case when [HRMS_Appraisal].[IsApproved]=1 then 'Lock' else 'UnLock' end

data.name: Query_SelectAppraisalAndDetailSearch_WithoutPaging
data.value:
SELECT
HRMS_Appraisal.AppraisalID, HRMS_Appraisal.DocumentNo, HRMS_Appraisal.DocumentDate,
HRMS_SET_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_SET_Employee.FullName,
HRMS_Appraisal.DepartmentID, HRMS_Appraisal.GradeID, HRMS_Appraisal.JobCategoryID, HRMS_Appraisal.DesignationID, HRMS_Appraisal.SectionID,
[HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[Comments], [HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[PromotionTo], [HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[PerformanceValue], [HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[ChangeEmployeeTypeID], [HRMS_AppraisalDetail].[EffectiveFrom],
HRMS_AppraisalDetail.AppraisalDetailID, HRMS_AppraisalDetail.AppraisalUserID, HRMS_AppraisalDetail.AppraisalDate,
APPC.AppraisalCode as AppraisalCodeP, APPC.AppraisalName as AppraisalNameP,
APCC.AppraisalCode as AppraisalCodeC, APCC.AppraisalName as AppraisalNameC,
HRMS_AppraisalDetail.AppraisalCode, HRMS_AppraisalDetail.RequiredRating, HRMS_AppraisalDetail.PerformanceRating, HRMS_AppraisalDetail.[Description], HRMS_AppraisalDetail.Comments, HRMS_Appraisal.StatusCode, HRMS_Appraisal.CreatedBy, HRMS_Appraisal.CreatedByValue, HRMS_Appraisal.UpdatedBy, HRMS_Appraisal.UpdatedByValue,
'Update' as Action
FROM HRMS_Appraisal
INNER JOIN HRMS_AppraisalDetail ON HRMS_AppraisalDetail.AppraisalID = HRMS_Appraisal.AppraisalID AND HRMS_AppraisalDetail.[CompanyID] = HRMS_Appraisal.[CompanyID] AND HRMS_AppraisalDetail.[PeriodID] = HRMS_Appraisal.[PeriodID] AND HRMS_AppraisalDetail.[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [HRMS_Set_Appraisal] APCC ON APCC.AppraisalCode = HRMS_AppraisalDetail.AppraisalCode AND APCC.[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [HRMS_Set_Appraisal] APPC ON APPC.AppraisalName = APCC.ParentAppraisalName AND APPC.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_SET_Employee ON HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_Appraisal.PersonID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_Appraisal.CompanyID AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1

where APP.Status = 1

data.name: Query_TMS_Alabbas
data.value:
SELECT fintab.TheDate,convert(varchar(2),TheDate,106)as NewDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, ( Case when fintab.DayDescription ='Monday' then 'Mon' when fintab.DayDescription ='Tuesday' then 'Tue' when fintab.DayDescription ='Wednesday' then 'Wed' when fintab.DayDescription ='Thursday' then 'Thu' When fintab.DayDescription ='Friday' then 'Fri' When fintab.DayDescription ='Saturday' then 'Sat' When fintab.DayDescription ='Sunday' then 'Sun' else '' end ) as ShortDay_Name, datename(month,fintab.TheDate) Month_Name, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,DepartmentName,ShiftName,ShiftCode,
ShiftTimeIN as STimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT as STimeOUT,
STimeIN,STimeOUT,MIN(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN,MAX(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName, fintab.JoiningDate,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end as AttStatus,
case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) else '----' end as Time_IN, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) else '----' end as Time_OUT,
case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end else case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Description = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' else 'A' end end as [Status], CONVERT(varchar(20),(Max(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN)),108)as CalculatedHours,IsOverTime, convert(varchar(5),Breaktime,108) Breaktime, --case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then --convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) --else '00:00' end as overtime, case when STimeOUT is null then ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then CONVERT(varchar(20),(Max(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when Max(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) else ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then
CONVERT(varchar(20),(Max(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when Max(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) end as OverTime, (DateDiff(s,MIN(TMSTimeIN),Max(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MIN(TMSTimeIN),MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 as TotWorkMinuts, case when Max(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then (DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotOverMinuts, --TerminalNo, TerminalNo1, TerminalNo2, case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountLeave,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountPresent, case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID)=0 then 1 else 0 end as CountAbsent,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate,
case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate , case when MIN(TMSTIMEIN) > ShiftTImeIn then (DateDiff(s, (ShiftTimeIN), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, (ShiftTImeIn ), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotlateMinuts,
case when MIN(TMSTIMEIN) > ShiftTImeIn then Convert(varchar(4),(DateDiff(s, (ShiftTimeIN), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))/3600)) +':'+ Convert(varchar(4),(DateDiff(s, (ShiftTimeIN), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))%3600/60)) else '0' end as LateHours,
case when MAX(TMSTimeOut) < ShiftTimeOut then Convert(Varchar(10),(DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60/60) +':'+ Convert(Varchar(20),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 ) else '0' end as EarlyOutHours
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.Reason, SS.ShiftCode, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS2.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName, (case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS2.TMSDateTime is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT, ETMS1.TerminalNo
from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) {1} and EP.Status=1 left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
-- left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 inner join HRMS_AttendanceRoaster ES on ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status = 1 and ES.ShiftFrom <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ShiftTo >= SET_DateTime.TheDate left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1 LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift ABC on SET_DateTime.THEDATE >= ABC.FromDate and SET_DateTime.THEDATE <= ABC.ToDate and ABC.Status=1 left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate {0} ) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 {2} group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,IsOverTime,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName,DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT,ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT,TerminalNo1,ShiftCode, TerminalNo2,STimeIN,STimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName,fintab.JoiningDate,fintab.Reason,fintab.Description,Breaktime Order by TheDate,EmployeeCode,Month_Name

data.name: Query_AlAbbas_OverTimeData
data.value:
Select -1 as OverTimeID,DatePart(Month,Max(TheDate))as Month,Month_Name as MonthName,PersonID,finaltab.CompanyID,EmployeeCode,PersonTypeCode,FullName,FatherName ,FK_JobDesignationID,DesignationName,DepartmentName,SectionName,LocationName,JoiningDate,SUM(TotOverMinuts) as TotalOverTime ,(Convert(float,(SUM(FinalTab.TotOverMinuts)) / 60.00 )) as TotalOT ,(SUM(FinalTab.TotOverMinuts) / 60) as TotalOTHours,(SUM(FinalTab.TotOverMinuts) % 60) as OTMinutes --,HRMS_ExtraOT_Rates.Rate as OTRate ,Round(Convert(float,(BasicSalary/30 / 8) * 1.25),2) as OTRate,BasicSalary, 0 as MgrApprovedHours,0 as HRApprovedHours,0 as FinalOTHours,0 as TotalAmount ,'' as Action from (
SELECT fintab.TheDate,convert(varchar(2),TheDate,106)as NewDate,FK_JobDesignationID,BasicSalary, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, ( Case when fintab.DayDescription ='Monday' then 'Mon' when fintab.DayDescription ='Tuesday' then 'Tue' when fintab.DayDescription ='Wednesday' then 'Wed' when fintab.DayDescription ='Thursday' then 'Thu' When fintab.DayDescription ='Friday' then 'Fri' When fintab.DayDescription ='Saturday' then 'Sat' When fintab.DayDescription ='Sunday' then 'Sun' else '' end ) as ShortDay_Name, datename(month,fintab.TheDate) Month_Name, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,DepartmentName,ShiftName,ShiftCode,
ShiftTimeIN as STimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT as STimeOUT
--STimeIN,STimeOUT ,MIN(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN,MAX(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName, fintab.JoiningDate,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end as AttStatus,
case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) else '----' end as Time_IN, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) else '----' end as Time_OUT,
case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end else case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Description = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' else 'A' end end as [Status], CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN)),108)as CalculatedHours,IsOverTime, convert(varchar(5),Breaktime,108) Breaktime, --case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then --convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) --else '00:00' end as overtime, case when STimeOUT is null then ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) else ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then
CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) end as OverTime, (DateDiff(s,MIN(TMSTimeIN),MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MIN(TMSTimeIN),MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 as TotWorkMinuts, case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then (DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotOverMinuts, --TerminalNo, TerminalNo1, TerminalNo2, case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountLeave,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountPresent, case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID)=0 then 1 else 0 end as CountAbsent,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate,
case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate , case when MIN(TMSTIMEIN) > ShiftTImeIn then (DateDiff(s, (ShiftTimeIN), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, (ShiftTImeIn ), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotlateMinuts, case when MAX(TMSTimeOut) < ShiftTimeOut then Convert(Varchar(10),(DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60/60) +':'+ Convert(Varchar(20),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 ) else '0' end as EarlyOutHours
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.Reason, SS.ShiftCode, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName, Ep.FK_JobDesignationID,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime ,Ep.Basicsalary, SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS2.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName, (case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS2.TMSDateTime is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT, ETMS1.TerminalNo
from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) {1} and EP.Status=1 left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
-- left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left join HRMS_AttendanceRoaster ES on ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status = 1 and ES.ShiftFrom <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ShiftTo >= SET_DateTime.TheDate left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1 LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift ABC on SET_DateTime.THEDATE >= ABC.FromDate and SET_DateTime.THEDATE <= ABC.ToDate and ABC.Status=1 left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate {0} ) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 {2} group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,IsOverTime,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName,DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT,ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT,TerminalNo1,ShiftCode, TerminalNo2,STimeIN,STimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName,fintab.JoiningDate,fintab.Reason,fintab.Description,Breaktime,FK_JobDesignationID ,BasicSalary -- Order by TheDate,EmployeeCode,Month_Name

inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_ExtraOT_Rates.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%over Time'
where finaltab.personID not in ( select PersonID from HRMS_OverTime where Datename(Month,FromDate) = finaltab.Month_Name and HRMS_OverTime.Status = 1)
group by Month_Name,PersonID,finaltab.CompanyID,EmployeeCode,PersonTypeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,FK_JobDesignationID ,DepartmentName,SectionName,LocationName,JoiningDate,Rate,BasicSalary

case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate , case when MIN(TMSTIMEIN) > ShiftTImeIn then (DateDiff(s, (ShiftTimeIN), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, (ShiftTImeIn ), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotlateMinuts, case when MAX(TMSTimeOut) < ShiftTimeOut then Convert(Varchar(10),(DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MAX(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60/60) +':'+ Convert(Varchar(20),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MAX(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 ) else '0' end as EarlyOutHours

SELECT SET_DateTime.Reason, SS.ShiftCode, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName, Ep.FK_JobDesignationID,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime ,Ep.Basicsalary, SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS2.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName, (case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS2.TMSDateTime is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT, ETMS1.TerminalNo
from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) {1} and EP.Status=1 left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
-- left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left join HRMS_AttendanceRoaster ES on ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status = 1 and ES.ShiftFrom <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ShiftTo >= SET_DateTime.TheDate left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1 LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift ABC on SET_DateTime.THEDATE >= ABC.FromDate and SET_DateTime.THEDATE <= ABC.ToDate and ABC.Status=1 left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate {0}
) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 {2} group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,IsOverTime,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName,DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT,ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT,TerminalNo1,ShiftCode, TerminalNo2,STimeIN,STimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName,fintab.JoiningDate,fintab.Reason,fintab.Description,Breaktime,FK_JobDesignationID ,BasicSalary -- Order by TheDate,EmployeeCode,Month_Name
) as finaltab
left join HRMS_ExtraOT_Rates on HRMS_ExtraOT_Rates.DesignationID = finaltab.FK_JobDesignationID
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_ExtraOT_Rates.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.Description like '%over Time'
inner join HRMS_OverTime on HRMS_OverTime.PersonID = finaltab.PersonID and Datename(Month,FromDate) = finaltab.Month_Name and ISNULL(HRApprovedhours,0) = 0 --where finaltab.personID not in ( select PersonID from HRMS_OverTime where Datename(Month,FromDate) = finaltab.Month_Name --and HRMS_OverTime.Status = 1)
group by Month_Name,finaltab.PersonID,finaltab.CompanyID,EmployeeCode,PersonTypeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,FK_JobDesignationID ,DepartmentName,SectionName,LocationName,JoiningDate,Rate,BasicSalary,HRMS_OverTime.OverTimeRate,MgrApprovedhours,HRMS_OverTime.OverTimeID

data.name: Query_GetOVerAllEmpDataForOVerTime
data.value:
SELECT -1 as OverTimeID,DatePart(Month,fintab.TheDate) as Month,Convert(date,fintab.TheDate) as CurrentDate ,FK_JobDesignationID,0 as TotalOT, 0 as TotalOTHours,0 as OTMinutes,0 as OTRate,0 as BasicSalary,0 as HRApprovedHours,0 as MgrApprovedHours ,0 as FinalOTHours,0 as TotalAmount ,fintab.TheDate,convert(varchar(2),TheDate,106)as NewDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, ( Case when fintab.DayDescription ='Monday' then 'Mon' when fintab.DayDescription ='Tuesday' then 'Tue' when fintab.DayDescription ='Wednesday' then 'Wed' when fintab.DayDescription ='Thursday' then 'Thu' When fintab.DayDescription ='Friday' then 'Fri' When fintab.DayDescription ='Saturday' then 'Sat' When fintab.DayDescription ='Sunday' then 'Sun' else '' end ) as ShortDay_Name, datename(month,fintab.TheDate) Month_Name, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,DepartmentName,ShiftName,ShiftCode,
ShiftTimeIN as STimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT as STimeOUT,
STimeIN,STimeOUT,MIN(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN,MAX(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName, fintab.JoiningDate,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end as AttStatus,
case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) else '----' end as Time_IN, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) else '----' end as Time_OUT,
case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end else case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Description = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' else 'A' end end as [Status], CONVERT(varchar(20),(Max(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN)),108)as CalculatedHours,IsOverTime, convert(varchar(5),Breaktime,108) Breaktime, --case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then --convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) --else '00:00' end as overtime, case when STimeOUT is null then ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then CONVERT(varchar(20),(Max(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when Max(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) else ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then
CONVERT(varchar(20),(Max(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when Max(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) end as OverTime, (DateDiff(s,MIN(TMSTimeIN),Max(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MIN(TMSTimeIN),MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 as TotWorkMinuts, case when Max(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then (DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotOverMinuts, --TerminalNo, TerminalNo1, TerminalNo2, case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountLeave,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountPresent, case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID)=0 then 1 else 0 end as CountAbsent,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate,
case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate , case when MIN(TMSTIMEIN) > ShiftTImeIn then (DateDiff(s, (ShiftTimeIN), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, (ShiftTImeIn ), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotlateMinuts,
case when MIN(TMSTIMEIN) > ShiftTImeIn then Convert(varchar(4),(DateDiff(s, (ShiftTimeIN), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))/3600)) +':'+ Convert(varchar(4),(DateDiff(s, (ShiftTimeIN), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))%3600/60)) else '0' end as LateHours,
case when MAX(TMSTimeOut) < ShiftTimeOut then Convert(Varchar(10),abs((DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60/60)) +':'+ Convert(Varchar(20),abs(DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 )) else '0' end as EarlyOutHours,
case when MAX(TMSTimeOut) < ShiftTimeOut then abs((DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else 0 end as EarlyOutMinutes
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.Reason, SS.ShiftCode, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS2.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName, (case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS2.TMSDateTime is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT, EP.FK_JobDesignationID,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT, ETMS1.TerminalNo
from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) {1} and EP.Status=1 left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
-- left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left join HRMS_AttendanceRoaster ES on ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status = 1 and ES.ShiftFrom <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ShiftTo >= SET_DateTime.TheDate left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1 LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift ABC on SET_DateTime.THEDATE >= ABC.FromDate and SET_DateTime.THEDATE <= ABC.ToDate and ABC.Status=1 left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate {0} ) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 {2}
where fintab.personID not in ( select PersonID from HRMS_OverTime where Datename(Month,FromDate) = datename(month,fintab.TheDate) and HRMS_OverTime.Status = 1)
group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,IsOverTime,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName,DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT,ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT,TerminalNo1,ShiftCode, TerminalNo2,STimeIN,STimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName,fintab.JoiningDate,fintab.Reason,fintab.Description,Breaktime,FK_JobDesignationID Order by TheDate,EmployeeCode,Month_Name

data.name: Query_TMS_AlAbbasWithRoaster
data.value:
--Declare @periodID int --set @periodID=1
--Declare @companyID int --set @companyID=1
--Declare @FromDate datetime --set @FromDate ='2018-11-01 00:00:00.000'
--Declare @ToDate datetime --set @ToDate='2018-11-30 00:00:00.000'
--drop table #tempTable
SELECT distinct SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,isNull(SET_DateTime.Reason,'') [Reason] , SS.HoursPerDay
--, SS.ShiftCode ,(case when (SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0) then (SELECT HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftCode FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' then LAG(SS.ShiftCode) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else SS.ShiftCode end) as ShiftCode
, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,EP.BasicSalary,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS.Time_OUT as TMSTimeOUT --,SS.[Description] as ShiftName ,(case when SET_DateTime.[Description] = 'Sunday' and isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID != 0 then (SELECT top 1 HRMS_Set_Shift.[Description] FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then LAG(SS.Description) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else SS.[Description] end) as ShiftName , ss.TimeIn ,ss.TimeOut
,EP.IsExtraOverTime, --(case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS.Time_OUT is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, '00:00' as Breaktime, case when ETMS.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT, ISNULL(ETMS1.reason,ETMS.Reason) as MAReason, case when ETMS1.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end isManualin ,case when ETMS.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end isManualOut,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) -- ,101) as ShiftTimeIN,
(case when SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0 then (SELECT top 1 CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),HRMS_Set_Shift.TimeIn,114) ,101) FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ',101) +LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) end) as ShiftTimeIN,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) --,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,

when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) and (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 'A' when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 'A' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 'A'

when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
else 'A' end) = 'P' and (case when stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (STimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') then 'L' else '' end) = 'L'
then (convert(varchar(2), DateDiff(Minute, stuff(convert(varchar(19), (STimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') , stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ')) / 60) + ':' + right('0' + convert(varchar(2), DateDiff(Minute, stuff(convert(varchar(19), (STimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') , stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ')) % 60), 2)) else '0:00' end ) as LateHours, --endNewLateHrsWorking

case when fintab.Reason !='' OR MAX(HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate) is not null then '0' when MAX(TMSTimeOut) < ShiftTimeOut then Case when ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 )<=15 and count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 60 when ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 ) > 15 and ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 ) <= 240 and count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 240 when ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 ) > 240 then 0 else 0 end else 0 end as EarlyOutMins,
case when fintab.Reason !='' OR MAX(HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate) is not null then '00:00' --when MAX(TMSTimeOut) < ShiftTimeOut then -- --Convert(Varchar(10),abs((DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60/60)) +':'+ Convert(Varchar(20),abs(DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 )) -- convert(varchar(2),replicate('0', 2 - len(abs((DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60/60)) + cast(abs((DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60/60) as varchar)) ) -- + ':' + -- convert(varchar(2),replicate('0', 2 - len(abs(DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 )) + cast(abs(DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 ) as varchar)) )
when MAX(TMSTimeOut) < ShiftTimeOut then Case when ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 )<=15 and count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then '01:00' when ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 ) > 15 and ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 ) <= 240 and count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then '04:00' when ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 ) > 240 then '00:00' else '00:00' end else '00:00' end as EarlyOutHours
,case when fintab.Reason !='' OR MAX(HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate) is not null then 0 when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 AND Count(LR.ShortLeaveType) >0 and ( ( select top 1 HalfDayCategory from HRMS_LeaveRequest LR2 left join HRMS_ShortLeaveType SR2 on SR2.ShortLeaveTypeID = LR2.ShortLeaveType left join HRMS_PayrollType PT2 on -- PT2.CompanyID=LR2.CompanyID and PT2.PayrollTypeID=LR2.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT2.PayrollTypeCode=LR2.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT2.[Status]=1 where LR2.HalfDayCategory = 1 and LR2.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR2.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and CONVERT(date,LR2.FromDate) <= fintab.TheDate and CONVERT(date,LR2.ToDate) >= fintab.TheDate and LR2.[Status]=1 and LR2.[IsApproved]=1 ) = 1
and
( select top 1 HalfDayCategory from HRMS_LeaveRequest LR2 left join HRMS_ShortLeaveType SR2 on SR2.ShortLeaveTypeID = LR2.ShortLeaveType left join HRMS_PayrollType PT2 on --PT2.CompanyID=LR2.CompanyID and PT2.PayrollTypeID=LR2.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT2.PayrollTypeCode=LR2.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT2.[Status]=1 where LR2.HalfDayCategory = 2 and LR2.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR2.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and CONVERT(date,LR2.FromDate) <= fintab.TheDate and CONVERT(date,LR2.ToDate) >= fintab.TheDate and LR2.[Status]=1 and LR2.[IsApproved]=1 ) = 2
) then 2
when fintab.Reason !='' OR MAX(HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate) is not null then 0 when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 AND Count(LR.ShortLeaveType) >0 then 1 else 0 end CountHalfDays ,fintab.Reason ,fintab.MAReason,fintab.isManualin,fintab.isManualOut ,HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate ,Isnull(fintab.IsExemptedFromGH,0) as IsExemptedFromGH from -- () #tempTable as fintab

left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 {2} -- where ((fintab.TerminalNo2 = 0 or fintab.TerminalNo2 is null) and ShiftCode is null or ShiftCode = '' ) Or (fintab.TerminalNo2 > 0 --and (ShiftCode is not null )) group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,IsOverTime,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName,DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT,ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT,TerminalNo1,ShiftCode, TerminalNo2,STimeIN,STimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName,fintab.JoiningDate,fintab.Reason,fintab.Description,Breaktime,IsExtraOverTime ,fintab.MAReason, isManualOut ,isManualin,fintab.BasicSalary ,fintab.IsNormalDay,HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate ,fintab.IsLateFine,fintab.IsAttendanceWaver ,fintab.IsExemptedFromGH Order by PersonID,TheDate,EmployeeCode,Month_Name
-------------------- leave Select fintab.PersonID, (fintab.Description) as Description, max(fintab.PayrollTypeID) as PayrollTypeID, sum(fintab.LeaveDays) as LeaveDays from ( Select HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID as PersonID,PayrollTypeID, Max(Case when PT.Description is null then HRMS_ShortLeaveType.ShortLeaveType else PT.Description end) as Description, (SUM(Case When HRMS_LeaveRequest.LeaveRequestType='1' --AND isnull(ES.ShiftID,0) = 0 then (Case When Datediff(DAY,HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate)='0' then 1 else (CAST((Datediff(DAY,HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate)) AS FLOAT )+ CAST(1 as float)) end) When HRMS_LeaveRequest.LeaveRequestType='2' then HRMS_ShortLeaveType.Count end ))as LeaveDays from HRMS_LeaveRequest

left join HRMS_ShortLeaveType on HRMS_ShortLeaveType.ShortLeaveTypeID=HRMS_LeaveRequest.ShortLeaveType and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ShortLeaveType is not null left join HRMS_AttendanceRoaster ES on ES.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and ES.Status = 1 --and ES.ShiftFrom <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ShiftTo >= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND CONVERT(date,ES.ShiftFrom)=Convert(date,HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate) left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1

left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate LEFT JOIN ( Select HRMS_TMSData.PersonID,HRMS_TMSData.ShiftHeaderID,HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime Time_IN --,MIN(OUTTS.TMSDateTime) Time_OUT ,( case when convert(Date,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime) = Convert(Date,Min(OUTTS.TMSDateTime)) then (Select max(HRMS_TMSData2.TMSDateTime) from HRMS_TMSData as HRMS_TMSData2 Where --HRMS_TMSData2.StatusCode=2 HRMS_TMSData2.StatusCode in (select StatusCode from HRMS_TMS_Status where Description = 'CheckOut') and Convert(Date,HRMS_TMSData2.TMSDateTime) = convert(Date,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime) and HRMS_TMSData2.PersonID=HRMS_TMSData.PersonID) else Min(OUTTS.TMSDateTime) end ) Time_OUT ,OUTTS.ManagementCode,OUTTS.TerminalNo,MIN(OUTTS.RawData) as RawData,OUTTS.Reason
from HRMS_TMSData
OUTER APPLY (Select EMTS2.PersonID,EMTS2.ShiftHeaderID,EMTS2.StatusCode,TMSDateTime,ManagementCode,TerminalNo,EMTS2.RawData,EMTS2.Reason from HRMS_TMSData EMTS2 Where --StatusCode=2 StatusCode in (select StatusCode from HRMS_TMS_Status where Description = 'CheckOut') AND EMTS2.TMSDateTime between @FromDate AND @ToDate AND EMTS2.TMSDateTime>=HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime
) as OUTTS
Where HRMS_TMSData.PersonID=OUTTS.PersonID --AND HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode=1 AND HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode in (select StatusCode from HRMS_TMS_Status where Description = 'CheckIn') AND HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime between @FromDate AND @ToDate
group by HRMS_TMSData.PersonID,HRMS_TMSData.ShiftHeaderID,HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime ,OUTTS.ManagementCode,OUTTS.TerminalNo,OUTTS.Reason
) as ETMS ON ETMS.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_IN)) ,101) = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate AND ( CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) ,101) = CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) OR DATEDIFF(hour, ETMS1.TMSDateTime, ETMS.Time_OUT)<=24 ) -- Get Time Out Against time in
Where HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate <=@ToDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate >= @FromDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=1 --AND ES.ShiftID is null {3} group by Fk_PersonID,PayrollTypeID,LeavePurpose,PT.Description,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ShortLeaveType) fintab
Group by fintab.PersonID, fintab.Description
having sum(fintab.LeaveDays) > 0.00
---- for dectuction select * from ( select HRMS_PayrollType.Description as LeaveType ,HRMS_EmployeePayroll .LeaveDays - isnull(( select count(LeaveRequestID) from HRMS_LeaveRequest inner join SET_PeriodCustom on HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate < @FromDate --SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate <= SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate where HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID and HRMS_LeaveRequest.status = 1 ),0) as Opening ,sortingOrder ,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID ,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID, ( Select isnull(sum((DATEDIFF(DAY, hlr.FromDate, DATEADD(Day, 1, hlr.ToDate)))), 0 )as diifd from HRMS_LeaveRequest hlr
where hlr.LeavePurpose not like '%auto Leave adjustment%' and hlr.FromDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = hlr.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = hlr.Fk_PersonID ) as DeductedTaken from HRMS_EmployeePayroll inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll .PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll .PayrollTypeCode inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on EP.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID and EP.Status=1 left join SET_EmployeeType ET on ET.TypeID = EP.PersonTypeCode and ET.Status = 1 where HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode=4 {4} )as tab where Opening > 0 order by sortingOrder

) as ETMS ON ETMS.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_IN)) ,101) = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate AND ( CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) ,101) = CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) OR DATEDIFF(hour, ETMS1.TMSDateTime, ETMS.Time_OUT)<=24 ) -- Get Time Out Against time in
Where HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate <=@ToDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate >= @FromDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=1 --AND ES.ShiftID is null {3} group by Fk_PersonID,PayrollTypeID,LeavePurpose,PT.Description,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ShortLeaveType) fintab
Group by fintab.PersonID, fintab.Description
having sum(fintab.LeaveDays) > 0.00

,HRMS_BonusDetail.CreateDate ,HRMS_BonusDetail.CreatedBy ,HRMS_BonusDetail.UpdateDate ,HRMS_BonusDetail.UpdatedBy ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName as EmployeeName ,HRMS_BonusDetail.DesignationID ,SET_Designation.DesignationName , SET_Department.DepartmentID ,SET_Department.DepartmentName ,HRMS_BonusDetail.Eligibility ,HRMS_BonusDetail.InComeTax, HRMS_BonusDetail.NetBonusAmount, HRMS_Employement_Status.Description as EmployeeStatusName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName ,HRMS_BonusDetail.NoOfDays as PresentDays ,HRMS_BonusDetail.ArrearOfBonus, HRMS_BonusDetail.DeductionOfBonus ,HRMS_BonusDetail.AdvanceSalary ,SET_Business.BusinessName +'-'+ SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as CompanyName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.JoiningDate ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_BankAccountID ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_BankBranchID ,AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName ,EmpAccountNo,BankName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.Email ,(SET_Business.BusinessName +'-'+ SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName) as CompanyName ,('BONUS SLIP FOR THE MONTH OF '+ Upper(DATEName(MONTH,CurrentManulDate)) +' YEAR '+ Convert(Varchar(11),DATEPART(YEAR,CurrentManulDate))) as BankBranchName FROM HRMS_BonusDetail Left Join HRMS_BonusHeader on HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID And HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID And Set_Company.CompanyId=HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID left Join SET_Business on SET_Business.IsActive = 1 inner Join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId= Set_Company.OperatingUnitId left --select FullName,EmployeeCode,max(GrossAmount) as GrossAmount,TopHeading,HeaderSorting,LoanTypeName,PayrollTypeCode from ( select distinct HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0)as GrossAmount,'Opening' AS TopHeading,1 AS HeaderSorting ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as LoanTypeName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode

INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID
where (cast(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate as date ) < @FromDate ) AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description
union all
select distinct HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0)as GrossAmount,'Sanction' AS TopHeading,10 AS HeaderSorting ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as LoanTypeName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee
INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID

INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
left join HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail on HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID
where (cast(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate as date) <= @ToDate) AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description
UNION ALL
select distinct HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, isnull(sum(HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.LoanDeduction),0) as GrossAmount,'Recovered' AS TopHeading,20 AS HeaderSorting ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as LoanTypeName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode

INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusDetail ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_BonusDetail.EmployeeID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusLoanDetail ON HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.BonusHeaderID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_BonusHeader ON HRMS_BonusHeader.BonusID = HRMS_BonusDetail.BonusHeaderID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_BonusDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.PeriodID = HRMS_BonusDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_BonusHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PayrollTypeID
where (cast(HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CreateDate as date) <=@ToDate) AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_BonusLoanDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description
UNION ALL
select HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, --HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount - SUM(ISNULL(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount,0)) as GrossAmount, (HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount) - (isnull((select sum(isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanDisburstAmount,0)) from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner inner join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.Status = 1 where HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID ),0)) as GrossAmount, 'Balance' AS TopHeading,100 AS HeaderSorting ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as LoanTypeName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee

INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
--left join HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail on HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID -- and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID -- and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID
where (cast(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CreateDate as date) <= @ToDate) AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} --Group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description,HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount --)tab -- group by FullName,EmployeeCode,TopHeading,HeaderSorting,LoanTypeName,PayrollTypeCode
