--Declare @periodID int --set @periodID=1
--Declare @companyID int --set @companyID=1
--Declare @FromDate datetime --set @FromDate ='2018-11-01 00:00:00.000'
--Declare @ToDate datetime --set @ToDate='2018-11-30 00:00:00.000'
--drop table #tempTable
SELECT distinct SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,isNull(SET_DateTime.Reason,'') [Reason]
--, SS.ShiftCode ,(case when (SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0) then (SELECT HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftCode FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' then LAG(SS.ShiftCode) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else SS.ShiftCode end) as ShiftCode
, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,EP.BasicSalary,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS.Time_OUT as TMSTimeOUT --,SS.[Description] as ShiftName ,(case when SET_DateTime.[Description] = 'Sunday' and isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID != 0 then (SELECT top 1 HRMS_Set_Shift.[Description] FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then LAG(SS.Description) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else SS.[Description] end) as ShiftName
,EP.IsExtraOverTime, --(case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS.Time_OUT is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, '00:00' as Breaktime, case when ETMS.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT, ISNULL(ETMS1.reason,ETMS.Reason) as MAReason, case when ETMS1.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end isManualin ,case when ETMS.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end isManualOut,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) -- ,101) as ShiftTimeIN,
(case when SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0 then (SELECT top 1 CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),HRMS_Set_Shift.TimeIn,114) ,101) FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ',101) +LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) end) as ShiftTimeIN,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) --,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
(case when SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0 then (SELECT top 1 CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),HRMS_Set_Shift.TimeOut,114) ,101) FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ',101) +LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID)
when ( SS.Description <> 'OD' and SS.Description = 'D' and convert(date,ETMS.Time_In) <> CONVERT(date,ETMS.Time_OUT) and SET_DateTime.Description = 'Saturday' and SS.Description <> 'Sunday' ) then CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2),DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT) - 1) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ',101) +LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID)
else CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) end) as ShiftTimeOUT,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) -- ,101) as STimeIN,
(case when SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0 then (SELECT top 1 CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),HRMS_Set_Shift.TimeINGrace,114) ,101) FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ',101) +LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) end) as STimeIN,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) --,101) as STimeOUT,
(case when SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0 then (SELECT top 1 CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),HRMS_Set_Shift.TimeOUTGrace,114) ,101) FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ',101) + LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID)

Where HRMS_TMSData.PersonID=OUTTS.PersonID AND HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode=1 AND HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime between @FromDate AND @ToDate
group by HRMS_TMSData.PersonID,HRMS_TMSData.ShiftHeaderID,HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime ,OUTTS.ManagementCode,OUTTS.TerminalNo,OUTTS.Reason
) as ETMS ON ETMS.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_IN)) ,101) = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate AND ( CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) ,101) = CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) OR DATEDIFF(hour, ETMS1.TMSDateTime, ETMS.Time_OUT)<=36 ) -- Get Time Out Against time in
Where HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate <=@ToDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate >= @FromDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=1 --AND ES.ShiftID is null {3} group by Fk_PersonID,PayrollTypeID,LeavePurpose,PT.Description,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ShortLeaveType) fintab
Group by fintab.PersonID, fintab.Description
having sum(fintab.LeaveDays) >0.00

--Declare @periodID int --set @periodID=1
--Declare @companyID int --set @companyID=1
--Declare @FromDate datetime --set @FromDate ='2020-11-01 00:00:00.000'
--Declare @ToDate datetime --set @ToDate='2020-11-30 00:00:00.000'
--drop table #tempTable
SELECT distinct SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,isNull(SET_DateTime.Reason,'') [Reason] , SS.HoursPerDay
--, SS.ShiftCode ,(case when (SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0) then (SELECT HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftCode FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' then LAG(SS.ShiftCode) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else SS.ShiftCode end) as ShiftCode
, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,EP.BasicSalary,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS.Time_OUT as TMSTimeOUT --,SS.[Description] as ShiftName ,(case when SET_DateTime.[Description] = 'Sunday' and isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID != 0 then (SELECT top 1 HRMS_Set_Shift.[Description] FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then LAG(SS.Description) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else SS.[Description] end) as ShiftName
,EP.IsExtraOverTime, --(case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS.Time_OUT is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, '00:00' as Breaktime, case when ETMS.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT, ISNULL(ETMS1.reason,ETMS.Reason) as MAReason, case when ETMS1.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end isManualin ,case when ETMS.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end isManualOut,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) -- ,101) as ShiftTimeIN,
(case when SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0 then (SELECT top 1 CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),HRMS_Set_Shift.TimeIn,114) ,101) FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ',101) +LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) end) as ShiftTimeIN,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) --,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
(case when SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0 then (SELECT top 1 CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),HRMS_Set_Shift.TimeOut,114) ,101) FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ',101) +LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID)
when ( SS.Description <> 'OD' and SS.Description = 'D' and convert(date,ETMS.Time_In) <> CONVERT(date,ETMS.Time_OUT) and SET_DateTime.Description = 'Saturday' and SS.Description <> 'Sunday' ) then CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2),DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT) - 1) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ',101) +LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID)
else CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) end) as ShiftTimeOUT,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) -- ,101) as STimeIN,
(case when SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0 then (SELECT top 1 CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),HRMS_Set_Shift.TimeINGrace,114) ,101) FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ',101) +LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) end) as STimeIN,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) --,101) as STimeOUT,
(case when SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0 then (SELECT top 1 CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),HRMS_Set_Shift.TimeOUTGrace,114) ,101) FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ',101) + LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID)
when ( SS.Description <> 'OD' and SS.Description = 'D' and convert(date,ETMS.Time_In) <> CONVERT(date,ETMS.Time_OUT) and SET_DateTime.Description = 'Saturday' and SS.Description <> 'Sunday' ) then CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2),DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT) - 1) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ',101) +LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID)
else CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) end) as STimeOUT,
ETMS1.TerminalNo ,EP.IsLateFine,EP.IsAttendanceWaver into #tempTable from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID in @CompanyID) {1} and EP.Status=1 left join SET_EmployeeType ET on ET.TypeID = EP.PersonTypeCode and ET.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
-- left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left join HRMS_AttendanceRoaster ES on ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ES.Status = 1 --and ES.ShiftFrom <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ShiftTo >= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND CONVERT(date,ES.ShiftFrom)=Convert(date,SET_DateTime.TheDate) left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1 --LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift ABC on SET_DateTime.THEDATE >= ABC.FromDate and SET_DateTime.THEDATE <= ABC.ToDate -- and ABC.Status=1 left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate LEFT JOIN ( Select HRMS_TMSData.PersonID,HRMS_TMSData.ShiftHeaderID,HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime Time_IN --,MIN(OUTTS.TMSDateTime) Time_OUT ,( case when convert(Date,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime) = Convert(Date,Min(OUTTS.TMSDateTime)) then (Select max(HRMS_TMSData2.TMSDateTime) from HRMS_TMSData as HRMS_TMSData2 Where --HRMS_TMSData2.StatusCode=2 HRMS_TMSData2.StatusCode in (select StatusCode from HRMS_TMS_Status where Description = 'CheckOut') and ((Convert(Date,HRMS_TMSData2.TMSDateTime) = convert(Date,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime)) --OR Convert(Date,HRMS_TMSData2.TMSDateTime) = DATEADD(DAY, 1, Convert(Date,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime)) ) and HRMS_TMSData2.PersonID=HRMS_TMSData.PersonID) else MIN(OUTTS.TMSDateTime) end ) Time_OUT ,OUTTS.ManagementCode,OUTTS.TerminalNo,MIN(OUTTS.RawData) as RawData,OUTTS.Reason
from HRMS_TMSData
OUTER APPLY (Select EMTS2.PersonID,EMTS2.ShiftHeaderID,EMTS2.StatusCode,TMSDateTime,ManagementCode,TerminalNo,EMTS2.RawData,EMTS2.Reason from HRMS_TMSData EMTS2 Where --StatusCode=2 StatusCode in (select StatusCode from HRMS_TMS_Status where Description = 'CheckOut') AND EMTS2.TMSDateTime between @FromDate AND (DATEADD(day, 2, @ToDate)) AND EMTS2.TMSDateTime>HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime
) as OUTTS
Where HRMS_TMSData.PersonID=OUTTS.PersonID --AND HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode=1 and HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode in (select StatusCode from HRMS_TMS_Status where Description = 'CheckIn') AND HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime between @FromDate AND (DATEADD(day, 2, @ToDate))
group by HRMS_TMSData.PersonID,HRMS_TMSData.ShiftHeaderID,HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime ,OUTTS.ManagementCode,OUTTS.TerminalNo,OUTTS.Reason
) as ETMS ON ETMS.PersonID = EP.PersonID and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_IN)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ( CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) ,101) = CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) OR DATEDIFF(hour, ETMS1.TMSDateTime, ETMS.Time_OUT)<=24 ) -- Get Time Out Against time in
where SET_DateTime.TheDate >= @FromDate and SET_DateTime.TheDate <= @ToDate and EP.IsActive = 1 --and SET_DateTime.TheDate >= EP.JoiningDate and ( (EP.JobEndingDate is not null and SET_DateTime.TheDate between EP.JoiningDate and EP.JobEndingDate) OR (EP.JobEndingDate is null and SET_DateTime.TheDate >= EP.JoiningDate) ) order by SET_DateTime.TheDate asc
-------------------- FOR Sandwich ;with Cte as (
Select SET_DateTime.Reason,SET_DateTime.TheDate,SET_DateTime.Description, EP.PersonID, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS.Time_OUT as TMSTimeOUT ,CASE when SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' OR IsHoliday=1 OR SET_DateTime.Reason!='' then 'P' when ETMS1.TMSDateTime is null OR ETMS.Time_OUT is null then 'A' else 'P' end Status from SET_DateTime inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID in @CompanyID) {1} and EP.Status=1 and EP.IsActive = 1 left join SET_EmployeeType ET on ET.TypeID = EP.PersonTypeCode and ET.Status = 1 and ET.IsActive = 1 left join HRMS_AttendanceRoaster ES on ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status = 1 AND CONVERT(date,ES.ShiftFrom)=Convert(date,SET_DateTime.TheDate) left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1 left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate LEFT JOIN ( Select HRMS_TMSData.PersonID,HRMS_TMSData.ShiftHeaderID,HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime Time_IN,MIN(OUTTS.TMSDateTime) Time_OUT ,OUTTS.ManagementCode,OUTTS.TerminalNo,MIN(OUTTS.RawData) as RawData,OUTTS.Reason
from HRMS_TMSData

) as OUTTS
Where HRMS_TMSData.PersonID=OUTTS.PersonID --AND HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode=1 and HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode in (select StatusCode from HRMS_TMS_Status where Description = 'CheckIn') AND HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime between @FromDate AND @ToDate
group by HRMS_TMSData.PersonID,HRMS_TMSData.ShiftHeaderID,HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime ,OUTTS.ManagementCode,OUTTS.TerminalNo,OUTTS.Reason
) as ETMS ON ETMS.PersonID = EP.PersonID and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_IN)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ( CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) ,101) = CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) OR DATEDIFF(hour, ETMS1.TMSDateTime, ETMS.Time_OUT)<=24 ) -- Get Time Out Against time in
{0}
) --------
SELECT fintab.TheDate,convert(varchar(2),TheDate,106)as NewDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, CAST(isnull(fintab.IsHoliday,0) AS INT) as IsHoliday, --(datediff(day, fintab.TheDate, dateadd(month, 1, fintab.TheDate))) as DaysInMonth, (datediff(day, @FromDate, @ToDate+1)) as DaysInMonth, ( Case when fintab.DayDescription ='Monday' then 'Mon' when fintab.DayDescription ='Tuesday' then 'Tue' when fintab.DayDescription ='Wednesday' then 'Wed' when fintab.DayDescription ='Thursday' then 'Thu' When fintab.DayDescription ='Friday' then 'Fri' When fintab.DayDescription ='Saturday' then 'Sat' When fintab.DayDescription ='Sunday' then 'Sun' else '' end ) as ShortDay_Name, datename(month,fintab.TheDate) Month_Name, fintab.CompanyID, fintab.PersonID, fintab.PersonTypeCode, EmployeeCode, FullName, FatherName, DesignationName, DepartmentName, (CASE WHEN max(TMSTimeOUT) is null and shiftName != 'OD' and min(STimeIN) is null then null else case when isnull(isNormalDay,0) = 1 and shiftName = 'OD' then LAG(ShiftName) OVER(ORDER BY fintab.TheDate,fintab.PersonID) else ShiftName end end ) as ShiftName,
max(isnull(fintab.HoursPerDay,0)) as HoursPerDay ,
(CASE WHEN max(TMSTimeOUT) is null and shiftName != 'OD' and min(STimeIN) is null then null else case when isnull(isNormalDay,0) = 1 and shiftName = 'OD' then LAG(ShiftCode) OVER(ORDER BY fintab.TheDate,fintab.PersonID) else ShiftCode end end) as ShiftCode,
ShiftTimeIN as STimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT as STimeOUT,
STimeIN,STimeOUT,min(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN ,max(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT -- ,CASE WHEN DateDiff(HOUR,MIN(TMSTimeIN),MAX(TMSTimeOUT)) >0 then -- LEAD(MAX(TMSTimeOUT))OVER (ORDER BY personID) END as ETimeOUT --,CASE WHEN DateDiff(HOUR,MIN(TMSTimeIN),MAX(TMSTimeOUT)) >0 then MAX(TMSTimeOUT) ELSE DATEADD(day, 1, MAX(TMSTimeOUT)) END as ETimeOUT ,SectionName,LocationName, fintab.JoiningDate,
--OldAttStatusWork
--case when ShiftCode is null and (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null or MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null) then 'No Shift Assigned' --else case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null and max(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'No Shift Assigned' --else case when (isnull(fintab.Reason,'') != '' OR MAX(HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate) is not null or isnull(fintab.IsHoliday,0) = 1 and min(STimeIN) is null) then '--' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN and MAX(LR.ShortLeaveType) is not null -- --and MAX(LR.HalfDayCategory) = 2 -- then 'Early In' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN and MAX(LR.ShortLeaveType) is not null -- --and MAX(LR.HalfDayCategory) = 2 -- then 'Late In' -- when MAX(LR.ShortLeaveType) is not null then '--' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' -- else '--' -- end -- + -- case when DataTypeIN=' * ' then ' * ' else '' end -- + fintab.isManualin+' / ' + -- case when (isnull(fintab.Reason,'') != '' OR MAX(HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate) is not null or isnull(fintab.IsHoliday,0) = 1 and min(STimeIN) is null) then '--' -- when MAX(LR.ShortLeaveType) is not null then '--' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then '--' -- else '--' -- end -- + fintab.isManualOut + -- case when DataTypeOUT=' * ' then ' * ' else '' end --end --end -- as AttStatus,

group by HRMS_TMSData.PersonID,HRMS_TMSData.ShiftHeaderID,HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime ,OUTTS.ManagementCode,OUTTS.TerminalNo,OUTTS.Reason
) as ETMS ON ETMS.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_IN)) ,101) = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate AND ( CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) ,101) = CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) OR DATEDIFF(hour, ETMS1.TMSDateTime, ETMS.Time_OUT)<=24 ) -- Get Time Out Against time in
Where HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate <=@ToDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate >= @FromDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=1 --AND ES.ShiftID is null {3} group by Fk_PersonID,PayrollTypeID,LeavePurpose,PT.Description,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ShortLeaveType) fintab
Group by fintab.PersonID, fintab.Description
having sum(fintab.LeaveDays) > 0.00

data.name: Query_DataTMS
data.value:
SELECT fintab.TheDate,convert(varchar(2),TheDate,106)as NewDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, ( Case when fintab.DayDescription ='Monday' then 'Mon' when fintab.DayDescription ='Tuesday' then 'Tue' when fintab.DayDescription ='Wednesday' then 'Wed' when fintab.DayDescription ='Thursday' then 'Thu' When fintab.DayDescription ='Friday' then 'Fri' When fintab.DayDescription ='Saturday' then 'Sat' When fintab.DayDescription ='Sunday' then 'Sun' else '' end ) as ShortDay_Name, datename(month,fintab.TheDate) Month_Name, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,DepartmentName,ShiftName,ShiftCode,
ShiftTimeIN as STimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT as STimeOUT,
STimeIN,STimeOUT,MIN(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN,MAX(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName, fintab.JoiningDate,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end as AttStatus,
case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) else '----' end as Time_IN, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) else '----' end as Time_OUT,
-- case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then --case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end -- else -- case --when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Description = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' --when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' --when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' -- else -- 'A' -- end -- end as [Status],
--newStatus
case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end
when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' --3 when (CASE WHEN max(TMSTimeOUT) is null and shiftName != 'OD' and min(STimeIN) is null then null else case when isnull(IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and shiftName = 'OD' then LAG(ShiftName) OVER(ORDER BY fintab.TheDate,fintab.PersonID) else ShiftName end end ) = 'OD' then 'OD'
else case
--4 -- when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) then 'A' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 'A' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'A'
----5 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108)< CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --else 'A' end when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) and (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 'A' when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 'A' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 'A'
--5 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, min(TMSTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108)< CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) -- and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
else 'A' end end as [Status],
--endNewStatus
CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN)),108)as CalculatedHours,IsOverTime, convert(varchar(5),Breaktime,108) Breaktime, --case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then --convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) --else '00:00' end as overtime, case when STimeOUT is null then ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) else ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then
CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) end as OverTime, (DateDiff(s,MIN(TMSTimeIN),MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MIN(TMSTimeIN),MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 as TotWorkMinuts, case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then (DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotOverMinuts, --TerminalNo, TerminalNo1, TerminalNo2, case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountLeave,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountPresent, case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID)=0 then 1 else 0 end as CountAbsent,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate,
case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate , case when MIN(TMSTIMEIN) > ShiftTImeIn then (DateDiff(s, ( case when STIMEIN is null then ShiftTimeIN else STIMEIN end ), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ( case when STIMEIN is null then ShiftTimeIN else STIMEIN end ), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotlateMinuts
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay, SET_DateTime.Reason, SS.ShiftCode, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS2.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName, (case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS2.TMSDateTime is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT, ETMS1.TerminalNo
from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) {1} and EP.Status=1 left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
-- left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) --and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left join HRMS_AttendanceRoaster ES on ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status = 1 --and ES.ShiftFrom <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ShiftTo >= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND CONVERT(date,ES.ShiftFrom)=Convert(date,SET_DateTime.TheDate) left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1 LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift ABC on SET_DateTime.THEDATE >= ABC.FromDate and SET_DateTime.THEDATE <= ABC.ToDate and ABC.Status=1 left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate {0} ) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 {2} group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,IsOverTime,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName,DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT,ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT,TerminalNo1,ShiftCode, TerminalNo2,STimeIN,STimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName,fintab.JoiningDate,fintab.Reason,fintab.Description,Breaktime ,fintab.IsNormalDay Order by TheDate,EmployeeCode,Month_Name

data.name: Query_GetAttendance
data.value: select Distinct Description,isnull((case when HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Quantity < 0 then 0 else (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Quantity) end),0) as Quantity , ( EmployeeCode + ' | ' + FullName) as FullName ,HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID from HRMS_EmployeeAttendance inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID and payrolltypecode = 4 and HRMS_PayrollType.status = 1 and isActive = 1 inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 where HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID = @CompanyID {0} {1}

data.name: Query_LoanRegisterEmployeeWise_LoanDateWise
data.value:
--select FullName,EmployeeCode,max(GrossAmount) as GrossAmount,TopHeading,HeaderSorting,LoanTypeName,PayrollTypeCode from ( select distinct HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0)as GrossAmount,'Opening' AS TopHeading,1 AS HeaderSorting ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as LoanTypeName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee
INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID
where (cast(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate as date ) < @FromDate ) AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description
union all
select distinct HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount),0)as GrossAmount,'Sanction' AS TopHeading,10 AS HeaderSorting ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as LoanTypeName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee
INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1 INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID
where (cast(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate as date) between @FromDate and @ToDate) AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description
UNION ALL
select distinct HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, isnull(sum(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount),0) as GrossAmount,'Recovered' AS TopHeading,20 AS HeaderSorting ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as LoanTypeName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee
INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
left join HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail on HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID
where (cast(HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanStartDate as date) <= @ToDate) AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0} Group by HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_PayrollType.Description
UNION ALL
select HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, --HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount - SUM(ISNULL(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanDisburstAmount,0)) as GrossAmount, (HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanAmount) - (isnull((select sum(isnull(HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanDisburstAmount,0)) from HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner inner join HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner on HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.CompanyID and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.Status = 1 and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetailinner.Status = 1 where HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID and HRMS_LoanSanctionDetailinner.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID ),0)) as GrossAmount, 'Balance' AS TopHeading,100 AS HeaderSorting ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description as LoanTypeName,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee
INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PersonID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
INNER JOIN HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail ON HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.CompanyID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.PeriodID AND HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.status = 1
--left join HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail on HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionDetailID -- and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID -- and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.Status = 1 --and HRMS_LoanPaymentDetail.LoanSanctionHeaderID = HRMS_LoanSanctionHeader.LoanSanctionHeaderID
INNER JOIN HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LoanSanctionDetail.PayrollTypeID

data.value:
SELECT fintab.TheDate,convert(varchar(2),TheDate,106)as NewDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, ( Case when fintab.DayDescription ='Monday' then 'Mon' when fintab.DayDescription ='Tuesday' then 'Tue' when fintab.DayDescription ='Wednesday' then 'Wed' when fintab.DayDescription ='Thursday' then 'Thu' When fintab.DayDescription ='Friday' then 'Fri' When fintab.DayDescription ='Saturday' then 'Sat' When fintab.DayDescription ='Sunday' then 'Sun' else '' end ) as ShortDay_Name, datename(month,fintab.TheDate) Month_Name, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,DepartmentName,ShiftName,ShiftCode, --(SELECT DAY(DATEADD(DD,-1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(mm, 0, GETDATE()) + 1, 0))) as NoofDay) as NoofDay, (SELECT DATEDIFF(day, @FromDate, @ToDate) AS number_of_days) as NoofDay , ShiftTimeIN as STimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT as STimeOUT,
STimeIN,STimeOUT,MIN(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN,MAX(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName, fintab.JoiningDate,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end as AttStatus,
case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) else '----' end as Time_IN, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) else '----' end as Time_OUT,
-- case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then --case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end -- else -- case --when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Description = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' --when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' --when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' -- else -- 'A' -- end -- end as [Status],
--newStatus
case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end
when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' --3 when (CASE WHEN max(TMSTimeOUT) is null and shiftName != 'OD' and min(STimeIN) is null then null else case when isnull(IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and shiftName = 'OD' then LAG(ShiftName) OVER(ORDER BY fintab.TheDate,fintab.PersonID) else ShiftName end end ) = 'OD' then 'OD'
else case
--4 -- when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) then 'A' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 'A' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'A'
----5 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108)< CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --else 'A' end when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) and (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 'A' when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 'A' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 'A'
--5 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, min(TMSTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108)< CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) -- and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
else 'A' end end as [Status],
--endNewStatus
CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN)),108)as CalculatedHours,IsOverTime, convert(varchar(5),Breaktime,108) Breaktime, --case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then --convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) --else '00:00' end as overtime, case when STimeOUT is null then ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) else ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then
CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) end as OverTime, (DateDiff(s,MIN(TMSTimeIN),MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MIN(TMSTimeIN),MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 as TotWorkMinuts, case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then (DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotOverMinuts, --TerminalNo, TerminalNo1, TerminalNo2, case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountLeave,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountPresent, case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID)=0 then 1 else 0 end as CountAbsent,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate,
case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate , case when MIN(TMSTIMEIN) > ShiftTImeIn then (DateDiff(s, ( case when STIMEIN is null then ShiftTimeIN else STIMEIN end ), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ( case when STIMEIN is null then ShiftTimeIN else STIMEIN end ), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotlateMinuts
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay, SET_DateTime.Reason, SS.ShiftCode, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS2.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName, (case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS2.TMSDateTime is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT, ETMS1.TerminalNo
from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID in @CompanyID) {3} and EP.Status = 1 and EP.IsActive = 1 {1} and EP.Status=1 left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
-- left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) --and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left join HRMS_AttendanceRoaster ES on ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status = 1 --and ES.ShiftFrom <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ShiftTo >= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND CONVERT(date,ES.ShiftFrom)=Convert(date,SET_DateTime.TheDate) left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1 and SS.IsActive = 1 LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift ABC on SET_DateTime.THEDATE >= ABC.FromDate and SET_DateTime.THEDATE <= ABC.ToDate and ABC.Status=1 and ABC.IsActive = 1 left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate -- {0}
where SET_DateTime.TheDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and EP.IsActive = 1 and ( (EP.JobEndingDate is not null and SET_DateTime.TheDate between EP.JoiningDate and EP.JobEndingDate) OR (EP.JobEndingDate is null and SET_DateTime.TheDate >= EP.JoiningDate) ) -- and SET_DateTime.TheDate >= EP.JoiningDate");// and SET_DateTime.TheDate <= isnull(EP.jobEndingDate,getdate())
) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1 and PT.IsActive = 1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1 and Set_Section.IsActive = 1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 and SET_Location.IsActive = 1 {2} group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,IsOverTime,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName,DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT,ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT,TerminalNo1,ShiftCode, TerminalNo2,STimeIN,STimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName,fintab.JoiningDate,fintab.Reason,fintab.Description,Breaktime ,fintab.IsNormalDay Order by TheDate,EmployeeCode,Month_Name
