--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108)< CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) -- and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
else 'A' end end as [Status],
--endNewStatus
CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN)),108)as CalculatedHours,IsOverTime, convert(varchar(5),Breaktime,108) Breaktime, --case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then --convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) --else '00:00' end as overtime, case when STimeOUT is null then ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) else ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then
CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) end as OverTime, (DateDiff(s,MIN(TMSTimeIN),MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MIN(TMSTimeIN),MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 as TotWorkMinuts, case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then (DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotOverMinuts, --TerminalNo, TerminalNo1, TerminalNo2, case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountLeave,
--case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountPresent, (
case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 0
when fintab.Reason != '' then 0 --3 when (CASE WHEN max(TMSTimeOUT) is null and shiftName != 'OD' and min(STimeIN) is null then null else case when isnull(isNormalDay,0) = 1 and shiftName = 'OD' then LAG(ShiftName) OVER(ORDER BY fintab.TheDate,fintab.PersonID) else ShiftName end end ) = 'OD' then 0
-- --4 -- when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) then 0 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 0 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 0
----5 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 1 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 1 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 1 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108)< CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 1 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 1 --else 0 end --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) then 'A3'
when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) and (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 0 when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 0 when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 0
--5 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 1
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 1
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 1
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108)< CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 1
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) -- and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 1
else 0 end ) as CountPresent, --case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID)=0 then 1 else 0 end as CountAbsent, ( case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 0
when fintab.Reason != '' then 0 --3 when (CASE WHEN max(TMSTimeOUT) is null and shiftName != 'OD' and min(STimeIN) is null then null else case when isnull(isNormalDay,0) = 1 and shiftName = 'OD' then LAG(ShiftName) OVER(ORDER BY fintab.TheDate,fintab.PersonID) else ShiftName end end ) = 'OD' then 0
--4 -- when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) then 1 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 1 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 1
----5 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 0 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 0 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 0 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108)< CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 0 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 0 --else 1 end --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) then 'A3'
when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) and (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 1 when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 1 when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 1
--5 when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 0 when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 0 when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 0 when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 0 when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 0
else 1 end ) as CountAbsent, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, -- case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate, ( case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 0
when fintab.Reason != '' then 0 --3 when (CASE WHEN max(TMSTimeOUT) is null and shiftName != 'OD' and min(STimeIN) is null then null else case when isnull(isNormalDay,0) = 1 and shiftName = 'OD' then LAG(ShiftName) OVER(ORDER BY fintab.TheDate,fintab.PersonID) else ShiftName end end ) = 'OD' then 0 --1 when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),STimeIN,108) then 1 when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),STimeIN,108) then 0 when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) then 0
else 0 end) as CountInLate, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate , case when MIN(TMSTIMEIN) > ShiftTImeIn then (DateDiff(s, ( case when STIMEIN is null then ShiftTimeIN else STIMEIN end ), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ( case when STIMEIN is null then ShiftTimeIN else STIMEIN end ), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotlateMinuts
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay, SET_DateTime.Reason, SS.ShiftCode, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS2.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName, (case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS2.TMSDateTime is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT, ETMS1.TerminalNo
from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID in @CompanyID) {3} and EP.Status = 1 and EP.IsActive = 1 {1} and EP.Status=1 left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
-- left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) --and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left join HRMS_AttendanceRoaster ES on ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status = 1 --and ES.ShiftFrom <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ShiftTo >= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND CONVERT(date,ES.ShiftFrom)=Convert(date,SET_DateTime.TheDate) left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1 and SS.IsActive = 1 LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift ABC on SET_DateTime.THEDATE >= ABC.FromDate and SET_DateTime.THEDATE <= ABC.ToDate and ABC.Status=1 and ABC.IsActive = 1 left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate {0} ) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1 and PT.IsActive = 1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1 and Set_Section.IsActive = 1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 and SET_Location.IsActive = 1 {2} group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,IsOverTime,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName,DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT,ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT,TerminalNo1,ShiftCode, TerminalNo2,STimeIN,STimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName,fintab.JoiningDate,fintab.Reason,fintab.Description,Breaktime ,fintab.IsNormalDay -- Order by TheDate,EmployeeCode,Month_Name ) tab3 group by tab3.EmployeeCode,tab3.Month_Name,tab3.FullName,tab3.FatherName Order by EmployeeCode,Month_Name

data.name: Query_AttendanceRegister_Monthwise
data.value:
--Declare @periodID int --set @periodID=1
--Declare @companyID int --set @companyID=1
--Declare @FromDate datetime --set @FromDate ='2018-11-01 00:00:00.000'
--Declare @ToDate datetime --set @ToDate='2018-11-30 00:00:00.000'
--drop table #tempTable
SELECT distinct SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,isNull(SET_DateTime.Reason,'') [Reason] , SS.HoursPerDay
--, SS.ShiftCode ,(case when (SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0) then (SELECT HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftCode FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' then LAG(SS.ShiftCode) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else SS.ShiftCode end) as ShiftCode
, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,EP.BasicSalary,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS.Time_OUT as TMSTimeOUT --,SS.[Description] as ShiftName ,(case when SET_DateTime.[Description] = 'Sunday' and isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID != 0 then (SELECT top 1 HRMS_Set_Shift.[Description] FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then LAG(SS.Description) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else SS.[Description] end) as ShiftName , ss.TimeIn ,ss.TimeOut
,EP.IsExtraOverTime, --(case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS.Time_OUT is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, '00:00' as Breaktime, case when ETMS.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT, ISNULL(ETMS1.reason,ETMS.Reason) as MAReason, case when ETMS1.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end isManualin ,case when ETMS.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end isManualOut,

-------------------- leave Select fintab.PersonID, (fintab.Description) as Description, max(fintab.PayrollTypeID) as PayrollTypeID, sum(fintab.LeaveDays) as LeaveDays from ( Select HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID as PersonID,PayrollTypeID, Max(Case when PT.Description is null then HRMS_ShortLeaveType.ShortLeaveType else PT.Description end) as Description, (SUM(Case When HRMS_LeaveRequest.LeaveRequestType='1' --AND isnull(ES.ShiftID,0) = 0 then (Case When Datediff(DAY,HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate)='0' then 1 else (CAST((Datediff(DAY,HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate)) AS FLOAT )+ CAST(1 as float)) end) When HRMS_LeaveRequest.LeaveRequestType='2' then HRMS_ShortLeaveType.Count end ))as LeaveDays from HRMS_LeaveRequest inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on EP.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and EP.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and EP.Status=1 Left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on -- PT.CompanyID=HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID PT.PayrollTypeID=HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1

group by HRMS_TMSData.PersonID,HRMS_TMSData.ShiftHeaderID,HRMS_TMSData.StatusCode,HRMS_TMSData.TMSDateTime ,OUTTS.ManagementCode,OUTTS.TerminalNo,OUTTS.Reason
) as ETMS ON ETMS.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_IN)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_IN)) ,101) = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate AND ( CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS.Time_OUT)) ,101) = CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) OR DATEDIFF(hour, ETMS1.TMSDateTime, ETMS.Time_OUT)<=24 ) -- Get Time Out Against time in
Where HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate <=@ToDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate >= @FromDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=1 --AND ES.ShiftID is null {3}
group by Fk_PersonID,PayrollTypeID,LeavePurpose,PT.Description,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ShortLeaveType) fintab
Group by fintab.PersonID, fintab.Description
having sum(fintab.LeaveDays) > 0.00
---- for dectuction select * from ( select HRMS_PayrollType.Description as LeaveType ,HRMS_EmployeePayroll .LeaveDays - isnull(( select count(LeaveRequestID) from HRMS_LeaveRequest inner join SET_PeriodCustom on HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate < @FromDate --SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate <= SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate where HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID and HRMS_LeaveRequest.status = 1 ),0) as Opening ,sortingOrder ,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID ,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID, ( Select isnull(sum((DATEDIFF(DAY, hlr.FromDate, DATEADD(Day, 1, hlr.ToDate)))), 0 )as diifd from HRMS_LeaveRequest hlr
where hlr.LeavePurpose not like '%auto Leave adjustment%' and hlr.FromDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = hlr.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = hlr.Fk_PersonID ) as DeductedTaken from HRMS_EmployeePayroll inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll .PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll .PayrollTypeCode inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on EP.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID and EP.Status=1 left join SET_EmployeeType ET on ET.TypeID = EP.PersonTypeCode and ET.Status = 1 where HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode=4 {4} )as tab where Opening > 0 order by sortingOrder
